boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented University of San Diego traditions spanning welcome-week rituals, faith gatherings, food, family connection, and Torero philanthropy.

cards.title: Alcalá Bazaar
cards.subtitle: Semester-opening involvement fair
cards.notes: Start with a lap of the booths, then save contacts for organizations or campus centers you want to revisit after classes begin.
cards.short_summary: USD’s biannual kickoff for discovering student organizations, university centers, and local resources.
cards.evidence_claim: USD describes the Alcalá Bazaar as a tradition that kicks off each fall and spring semester and connects students with involvement opportunities.
cards.source_title: New Opportunities Abound at Festive Alcalá Bazaar
cards.access_notes: Held at the start of fall and spring semesters; check Student Activities and Involvement programming for the current date and location.

cards.title: Mass of the Holy Spirit
cards.subtitle: Opening-of-year campus gathering
cards.notes: If you attend, arrive ready for a reflective community service marking the academic year and welcoming new Toreros.
cards.short_summary: A university-wide early-fall service that rededicates the community to USD’s mission.
cards.evidence_claim: USD states that it celebrates the Mass of the Holy Spirit at the start of every academic year as a festive gathering of the university community.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled at the beginning of the academic year; the current event listing supplies time and venue.

cards.title: All Faith Service
cards.subtitle: Spring-semester multifaith gathering
cards.notes: Join the spring gathering to hear reflections and music representing several faith traditions in the USD community.
cards.short_summary: An annual, explicitly multifaith USD tradition centered on peace, solidarity, and religious diversity.
cards.evidence_claim: USD calls the All Faith Service an annual USD tradition and says it is a peaceful space rather than a Mass or church service.
cards.access_notes: Celebrated at the start of the spring semester; all are welcome according to USD’s event announcement.

cards.title: Light Up Colachis Plaza
cards.subtitle: Annual holiday tree-lighting ceremony
cards.notes: Look for the campus announcement in late fall, then gather at the ceremony before returning later to see the tree lit.
cards.short_summary: A campus holiday ritual with student leaders, carolers, refreshments, and a tree that remains lit through the season.
cards.evidence_claim: USD characterizes its campus Christmas tree lighting as a beloved annual tradition welcoming the holiday season.
cards.access_notes: Occurs during the holiday season; confirm the current year’s ceremony details with USD events.

cards.title: Leave the Senior Class Legacy
cards.subtitle: Graduating-class scholarship support
cards.notes: Graduating seniors can learn about the committee or make a gift of any size to the scholarship fund when participation opens.
cards.short_summary: A 30-year USD senior tradition of helping future Toreros through scholarship support.
cards.evidence_claim: USD says Senior Class Legacy has been a proud USD tradition for 30 years and invites graduating seniors to support its scholarship fund.
cards.access_notes: For graduating seniors; participation and committee information are provided by University Advancement.

cards.title: Bring Family for Spring Weekend
cards.subtitle: Cherished USD family tradition
cards.notes: Coordinate with visiting family early and use the published weekend schedule to choose events you can share on campus.
cards.short_summary: A spring weekend designed for grandparents and families to experience USD alongside their student.
cards.evidence_claim: USD calls Grandparents and Family Spring Weekend a cherished USD tradition and lists its next occurrence for February 19–21, 2027.
cards.access_notes: Next listed dates are February 19–21, 2027; event registration or individual activities may have separate requirements.

cards.title: Mark Torero Tuesday
cards.subtitle: USD’s annual day of giving
cards.notes: Follow the annual campaign to see which campus initiatives are eligible, then share or support a cause that matters to you.
cards.short_summary: A global Torero giving day that directs support toward USD programs and student-focused initiatives.
cards.evidence_claim: USD identifies Torero Tuesday as its annual day of giving, when Toreros around the world support areas of campus life.
cards.access_notes: Annual campaign; check USD Giving for the current date and participating initiatives.

cards.title: Thanksgiving Dinner on Campus
cards.subtitle: Campus Dining’s November tradition
cards.notes: Check Campus Dining’s special-events calendar before November for the current dinner details and applicable meal-plan access.
cards.short_summary: A November dining event that USD itself labels a tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: USD Campus Dining lists Thanksgiving Dinner in November and labels it “A USD Tradition.”
cards.access_notes: Listed as a November special event; meal access, timing, and location should be confirmed with Campus Dining.

cards.title: Our Lady of Guadalupe Mass
cards.subtitle: Signature USD Spanish-language observance
cards.notes: Watch University Ministry and campus event listings near December for the current observance details and service location.
cards.short_summary: A signature USD event conducted in Spanish as part of the university’s longstanding campus tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: USD describes the Our Lady of Guadalupe Mass as one of its signature events offered in Spanish within a long campus tradition.
cards.access_notes: Look for the current University Ministry schedule near the feast day in December.

cards.title: Farmworker’s Mass
cards.subtitle: Signature USD Spanish-language observance
cards.notes: Use current University Ministry announcements to confirm the service date, then attend respectfully as a campus community observance.
cards.short_summary: A named USD mass included among the university’s longstanding Spanish-language signature events.
cards.evidence_claim: USD identifies the Farmworker’s Mass, alongside the Our Lady of Guadalupe Mass, as a signature event offered in Spanish within a long tradition.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current service schedule with University Ministry or USD event announcements.
